lastTask: Implement Byte 13b-c2 musical event payload and buffer boundary

projectState.summary: Byte 13b-c2 defines the musical-event persistence shape without writing high-frequency events yet. `MusicalEvent` now carries `gridPitch` from committed material and `performedPitch` from the sounded decision while preserving `pitch` as the performed-pitch compatibility field. `src/musical-event-record.ts` owns schema-v1 `MusicalEventRecordPayload` with `grid` and `performed` sections plus a fixed-capacity drop-oldest ring buffer. Tests cover payload grid/performed pitch, buffer order/back-pressure, and live shift-register events with divergent grid/performed pitch. Next slice should wire musical events into the buffer and a separate batch flusher without fetch/timer/DB work inside Tone callbacks.
